Name: Obed-edom the Gittite
Summary: Obed-edom the Gittite kept the ark in his house for three months after Uzzah's death, and the Lord blessed him and all his household. David then brought the ark up from his house to Jerusalem with gladness.
KeyStory: Obed-edom housed the ark for three months and was blessed for it.
KeyVerses: 2 Samuel 6:10; 2 Samuel 6:11; 2 Samuel 6:12; 1 Chronicles 13:13; 1 Chronicles 13:14; 1 Chronicles 15:18
LifeLesson: Housing God's presence in fear and reverence brings blessing to a whole household.
